project.visitorDecision: Choose an appropriate Gooseberry Falls outing by available time, accessibility preference and season without assuming current trail access.
project.primaryAction: Open the official DNR trail map and park notices for the suggested outing before travel.

claims.subject: route-guidance
claims.limitation: These are typical DNR route time ranges, not guarantees of current trail access or visitor pace.

claims.subject: parking-rule
claims.limitation: Permit exceptions are specific to the visitor-center wayside; other in-park areas have different permit rules.

claims.subject: park-access
claims.limitation: No trustworthy structured official trail-closure feed was integrated; current access requires checking DNR notices and signs.

claims.subject: weather-context
claims.limitation: Weather is for the park vicinity, never direct proof that any route is open or that the river is safely crossable.

claims.subject: river-flow
claims.limitation: The monitoring location lacks continuous water-flow data; the tool does not invent a live river-level trend.

decisionState.sourceOfTruth: Pure normalize/chooseOuting engine in public/assets/gooseberry-engine.mjs; weather alerts only add regional caution.
decisionState.unavailableBehavior: When map, access or forecast information is unavailable, keep a DNR-sourced outing and provide official maps, notices and directions.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Recommend the 30–45-minute Upper and Middle Falls walk, preserving margin within an hour.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: DNR time guidance is typical; actual park access is unverified.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Recommend the 45–90-minute three-falls loop with non-ADA terrain disclosed.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: DNR guidance supports the loop, but does not certify opening or conditions.

scenarios.input: Choose 90 minutes and then return to 60 minutes
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Restore the Upper and Middle Falls recommendation, details, selected card and share URL.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: The park access qualifier remains unverified after reversing inputs.

scenarios.input: Disable JavaScript in the visitor browser
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Show a readable default Upper and Middle Falls answer, plus DNR source and official map.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No dynamic forecast is implied when JavaScript is disabled.

scenarios.input: Block both CARTO and OpenStreetMap tile images
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Show a compact map fallback and links to DNR summer and winter maps.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: The lack of a map must not become guessed route geometry.

scenarios.input: Break or expire the forecast/alert feed
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Retain the route suggestion but label forecast unavailable and link to NWS.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Do not promote an old forecast into a current safety or access decision.

scenarios.input: Step-free preference on a snow-free visit
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Prefer Upper and Middle with the switchback option and explain the Lower Falls loop is not ADA accessible.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Surface conditions remain subject to current official notices.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Recommend the Upper Falls winter walking approach rather than the complete three-falls loop.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: River ice is never safe and groomed ski routes are for their designated use.

scenarios.input: Prefer Lake Superior shoreline during a 90-minute visit
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Choose Picnic Flow and shoreline with a separate vehicle-permit consequence.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Exact shore access and trail surface are unverified; use the signed official map.

failures.no-js: Serve the DNR-backed Upper/Middle walk, main map link and official source in HTML before client enhancement.
failures.no-tiles: Collapse an unrendered map and retain official PDF maps and the street-address directions action.
failures.no-image: Keep the outing text and source-linked answer without a blank photo panel or stale caption.
failures.stale-data: Label regional NWS weather unavailable, preserve outing caveats, and avoid using older forecast as current access guidance.

qa.scopeNote: Fixture-based Chromium interactions and loaded photographs were checked; a separate public browser smoke confirmed real CARTO tiles after the hotfix. This record checker cannot repeat those checks.
